_comment: Decision-gate chart inputs (dashboard.md quadrant). energy = mean Mood/Energy of blocks in energy_categories this cycle, scaled (e-1)/9; plotted only with >= min_energy_ratings ratings. feasibility = 0..1 judgement from the path's non-energy criteria in roadmap/life-map.md section 3 (skills fit, market access, admissibility, funding, economics). null = not yet scored; set it during /intake or /quarterly, never from mood, and log the reason in that review.
